parameters.content:
## 1 · Settings
Edit **Config** only. `dry_run: true` = Google checks every change but applies nothing. Keep it on for 1–2 weeks.

## 2 · Pull data (read-only)
Five GAQL reports: account spend, campaigns this month and last 30 days, keywords, search terms. If any fails, the run stops — never optimize on missing data.

## 3 · Decide
**Rules Engine** does the math (CPA, pacing, bids, Quality Score). **Claude** only judges unclear search terms. The merge node accepts only terms it actually sent to Claude.

## 4 · You approve
Email with every change and why. Approve = apply all. Reject or no answer in 20 h = nothing changes.

## 5 · Apply + log
One request per API endpoint, `partialFailure` on, every change written to the **Change Log** tab.
